name: debtlens-vscode
description: Show DebtLens maintainability findings as VS Code diagnostics.

debtlens.executable.description: DebtLens CLI executable. Use an absolute path if debtlens is not on PATH.

debtlens.scanOnSave.description: Run DebtLens for the containing workspace folder when a file is saved.

debtlens.extraArgs.description: Extra arguments appended before --format json, for example --pack core,python.
